Concerning encoding complexity, the use of a fixed size of PU and TU, in addition to a fast intraprediction mode decision algorithm, allows reducing the complexity of the RDO stage, which is the computationally intensive process in the intraframe HEVC encoder architecture. The simulation results reveal that the HEVC quality exceeds that of other similar lightweight compression schemes using lossless and near-lossless approaches, showing a strong quality robustness for three cascaded concatenation cycles including pixel shifting processing.
